item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00381","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C10","C25","C02"],"selected_candidate_label":"C10","confidence":0.91,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C10 plausibly supplied the concrete template for the child's Export Control Review Board: both establish a high-level interdepartmental body chaired by the Secretary of Commerce, include the Secretaries of State and Defense, permit participation by other interested agencies when relevant matters are considered, and use the body to formulate recommendations on major policy questions. The child adapts that machinery from general trade policy to particular export-license matters. C25 and C02 share the delegation, supersession, and continuity structure, but those similarities are more conventional and less distinctive than C10's board design.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"There is hereby established the Export Control Review Board... composed of the Secretary of Commerce, who shall be the Chairman... the Secretary of State, and the Secretary of Defense.","parent_excerpt":"There is hereby established the Trade Policy Committee, consisting of the Secretary of State... the Secretary of Defense... [and] the Secretary of Commerce... The Secretary of Commerce... shall be the Chairman.","explanation":"The same three principal departments form the core of an interdepartmental policy body chaired by Commerce."},{"child_excerpt":"The Board may invite the heads of Government agencies... to participate in the activities of the Board when matters of interest to such agencies are under consideration.","parent_excerpt":"The Committee may invite the participation in its activities of other Government agencies when matters of interest thereto are under consideration.","explanation":"This is distinctive, closely parallel language governing ad hoc participation by agencies with an interest in the matter."},{"child_excerpt":"The Board shall consider the matters so referred to it... and shall make recommendations thereon to the Secretary of Commerce.","parent_excerpt":"The Trade Policy Committee shall make recommendations to the President on basic policy issues arising in the administration of the trade-agreements program.","explanation":"Both assign the interdepartmental body an advisory role for major policy questions arising during administration of a trade-control program, with the child redirecting recommendations to the delegated decision-maker."}]}
